title: Execute alias-safe post-W4 static-position W4A8 candidate

fresh_attempt_namespace.execution_marker_creation_rule: Create atomically exactly once only after the complete pre-attempt artifact set and every bound hash pass verification.

source_assertions: After pinned-model load, lm_head.weight and model.embed_tokens.weight are the same Parameter object.
After pinned-model load, lm_head.weight and model.embed_tokens.weight have the same storage data pointer.
The complete source embedding BF16 byte stream has SHA-256 4e96b0df6d274768cbb7e72404011853d23349999b658dc2f4dfb3c431ea223f.
split_operation: Before any W4 reconstruction, make one detached byte-identical clone of model.embed_tokens.weight on the same dtype and device.
Replace only lm_head.weight with a non-trainable Parameter backed by that clone.
Set the in-memory candidate config tie_word_embeddings field to false and never call tie_weights, reload a state dict, or otherwise retie storage after the split.
post_split_assertions: lm_head.weight and model.embed_tokens.weight are different Parameter objects with different storage data pointers.
Before W4 reconstruction, the complete lm_head and embedding BF16 byte streams are byte-identical.
The model.embed_tokens Parameter object, storage data pointer, shape, dtype, and complete BF16 byte hash are unchanged from source load.
w4_application: Apply the authenticated signed-W4 per-output-row Scale32 rule to exactly the 168 transformer Linear weights and the separated lm_head weight.
Never write through model.embed_tokens.weight and never include model.embed_tokens in a generic module rewrite traversal.
After W4 reconstruction, recheck the complete embedding BF16 byte hash and record the separated lm_head W4 representation hash.
tied_lm_head_embed_tokens_policy.failure_rule: Any failed identity, alias, pointer, shape, dtype, byte-equality, module-count, or embedding-hash assertion fails before table derivation and before any official execution marker exists.

position_classes.prompt: positions one through original prompt length minus one
position_classes.decode: positions at or beyond original prompt length

static_table_derivation_and_preflight.derivation_candidate: Construct candidate A from the pinned source using the exact tied-weight policy, complete every W4 rewrite, then collect per-layer, per-event, per-position-class, per-group absolute maxima using only the frozen non-evaluator inputs.
static_table_derivation_and_preflight.table_encoding: For each collected maximum divided by 127, choose the smallest normalized Scale32 record whose represented range covers the value. Saturation and silent clipping are forbidden.
static_table_derivation_and_preflight.table_freeze: Serialize the complete table canonically, record its SHA-256 and coverage manifest, and prohibit table mutation after the hash is bound.
static_table_derivation_and_preflight.fresh_replay_candidate: Destroy candidate A; independently reconstruct candidate B from the pinned source with the exact tied-weight policy; require the embedding, separated lm_head W4, 168 transformer W4, and complete candidate-state manifest hashes to match candidate A before replay.

additional_prompts: Name one primary color in one lowercase word.
Return only the integer result of 9 multiplied by 7.
In five words, describe gentle rain.
Answer yes or no: Is water wet?

required_before_marker: hash-bound runner source and self-test result
candidate-construction manifest for candidates A and B
canonical static Scale32 table and coverage manifest
predeclared contract binding every source, model, matrix, table, runner, tool-version, and policy hash
PREATTEMPT_READY.json that verifies all prior artifacts without creating execution_started.json

official_attempt_contract.generation: deterministic greedy argmax; no sampling; use_cache=false; maximum six generated tokens; termination IDs 151643 and 151645
official_attempt_contract.score_policy: binary only: 9/9 complete token arrays exactly equal BF16 and 9/9 response-gate outcomes equal BF16
official_attempt_contract.evaluator_no_execution_rule: If execution_started.json exists but no candidate prompt completes, preserve the attempt, keep numerical correctness null, and forbid replay.
official_attempt_contract.numerical_failure_rule: If any candidate prompt completes but the binary gate is not met, set eligible=false, preserve exact disagreements, keep selected_policy_id null, and forbid replay.
official_attempt_contract.numerical_success_rule: If the 9/9 binary gate is met, seal immutable evidence and submit it to a Fresh Reviewer; do not select the policy or authorize downstream work before independent acceptance.

engineer_objective: Implement and self-test the V2 runner without modifying V1 artifacts; construct and prove the exact alias-safe post-W4 state; derive, freeze, and fresh-state-preflight the fixed table using only non-evaluator prompts; then consume exactly one attempt-0001 only after pre-attempt closure and submit immutable evidence to a Fresh Reviewer.
acceptance_check: A Fresh Reviewer independently verifies the task, pre-attempt chronology, exact tied-weight policy, zero-overflow post-W4 preflight, one consumed attempt, and 9/9 exact BF16 token-sequence plus response-gate agreement; selected_policy_id changes only after that adjudication.
prohibited_work: modify, reclaim, resume, rename, replay, or reinterpret either consumed Option-B attempt
create the V2 execution marker during planning, runner development, table derivation, or preflight
use any official nine-prompt input for calibration, table derivation, or preflight
modify RTL, testbenches, formal properties, synthesis constraints, certified PPA evidence, or the sealed two-token record
retarget or claim the arbitrary-text demo
begin U280 integration, emulation, bitstream, or board work
